acceptance: A carry decline is one coded event naming the cycle, each failing gate and its output tail
No untagged multi-line stderr block remains for a decline
fix: Have the runner return per-gate status plus the tail, and have core emit one coded Signal Center event per decline carrying the cycle, the failing gates and the tail (precedent: C5's ORCHESTRATOR_REBASE_REENTRY_ABORTED).
summary: C6 (2026-09-29) made a failing composed-tree gate print its name, target, worktree and output tail to stderr, but the gate runner still flattens each result to the string "fail" in a map[string]string, and core prints the decline separately, so with several lanes in one loop log the two lines cannot be tied to a cycle (architecture review M3).
title: A declined carry names its failing composed gate in one coded Signal Center event, not untagged stderr
